prefill.timing_method: adapter call records (CLOCK_MONOTONIC) in the measured window; each interval from a call's start to the next call's start charged to that call's phase (non-overlapping, includes host gaps, CCL, sampling and readback waits)
prefill.work_method: useful prompt FLOPs from executed prefill rows x HF config (2 x active matmul params + causal attention + LM head once per request)
prefill.peak_source: tt-perf-report ArchitectureSpec 'blackhole' (110 worker cores, 4096 FLOP/cycle/core at 1.35 GHz, HiFi2 = /2; DRAM 512 GB/s per chip) x 4 chips
